samuel1.7.p1.b1.text: Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took it into Abinadab’s house on the hill. …

samuel1.7.p1.b2.text: And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD.

samuel1.7.p1.b3.text: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim. …

samuel1.7.p1.b4.text: And all the house of Israel mourned and sought after the LORD.

samuel1.7.p2.b1.text: “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. …

samuel1.7.p2.b2.text: And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.”

samuel1.7.p2.b3.text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.

samuel1.7.p3.b1.text: “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.”

samuel1.7.p3.b2.text: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted …

samuel1.7.p3.b4.text: And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.

samuel1.7.p4.b1.text: … their rulers marched up toward Israel. And when the Israelites learned of this, they feared the Philistines …

samuel1.7.p4.b2.text: “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.”

samuel1.7.p4.b3.text: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on behalf of Israel, and the LORD answered him.

samuel1.7.p5.b1.text: But that day the LORD thundered loudly against the Philistines and threw them into such confusion …

samuel1.7.p5.b3.text: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car.

samuel1.7.p6.b1.text: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer …

samuel1.7.p6.b2.text: “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”

samuel1.7.p6.b3.text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped invading the territory of Israel.

samuel1.7.p6.b4.text: Every year he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all these places.

samuel1.7.p6.b5.text: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there, … and built an altar to the LORD.
